title: Document it on p.apyr.us
description:
Feature page: the two records, corrections, editing and the draft editor, manual mode, newsletter assembly, guideline files, and what a pod's review does and does not prove. Every Papyrus feature epic ends with a p.apyr.us page. Do not boast about speed; state claims as fact.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Page published on p.apyr.us and linked from the docs index.
- Says plainly that pod review stamps are claims, not newsroom review.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
